title: Extend batch CSV with reusable assignments
description: Add reusableTasks to the deterministic version-1 batch CSV header and subset handling. Encode ordered canonical definition UUIDs with the existing CSV list convention; blank cells preserve assignments, populated cells replace them, and _clear may explicitly clear reusableTasks. Reject ambiguous simultaneous value-and-clear input, duplicate identifiers, malformed list syntax, unknown headers, and invalid _clear names while deferring definition existence to provider validation. Preserve UTF-8/BOM behavior and backward compatibility for imported CSV files whose headers omit the new optional column where the existing subset contract permits it. Add focused round-trip and rejection tests for commas/quoting, empty values, reorder, clear, duplicate entries, and deterministic export.

comments.message: Implemented reusableTasks in batch CSV: deterministic header column, ordered comma-list encode/decode with CSV quoting, blank-preserve/explicit _clear semantics, duplicate and malformed-list rejection, conflict handling, subset/BOM compatibility, and provider-deferred identifier resolution. Batch export now emits stored canonical reusable-definition UUIDs in order (including explicit clear for empty assignments); focused codec/export/JSON/import/CLI tests pass.
